series.name: Tempting the Ruthless CEO
series.summary: Aria confronts Sebastian at the Sterling Estate ballroom before Julian charges in to physically subdue his treacherous half-brother. After Victoria crushes the countdown device only to learn it was a live broadcast leak, Julian pulls Aria back to the penthouse and confesses the shocking truth behind his sacrifice.

chars.name: Aria Bennett
chars.desc: 24-year-old female, fair porcelain skin, waist-length wavy dark chestnut hair, delicate doe eyes, high cheekbones, wearing a tailored lavender wool trench coat over a minimalist cream silk slip dress
chars.role: Disgraced heiress operating undercover as a timid corporate assistant to clear her family's name; sharp-witted, fiercely determined, yet fighting her growing attraction to Julian

chars.name: Victoria Sterling
chars.desc: 26-year-old female, sun-kissed tan skin, sleek platinum blonde blunt bob, feline green eyes with sharp winged liner, defined contour, wearing an emerald-green silk halter gown and diamond teardrop earrings
chars.role: Status-obsessed socialite intended to marry Julian; vindictive, cunning, and determined to publicly ruin Aria the moment she detects competition

chars.name: Sebastian Vance
chars.desc: 29-year-old male, pale skin, sharply styled golden-blonde undercut, narrow calculating steel-blue eyes, thin mocking lips, wearing a sharp navy double-breasted designer blazer with gold crest buttons
chars.role: Julian's ruthless half-brother and Aria's treacherous ex-fiancé who framed her father; outwardly charismatic, secretly manipulative and possessive

chars.name: Julian Thorne
chars.desc: 28-year-old male, olive skin tone, raven-black hair slicked back with a few rogue strands over his forehead, piercing hazel eyes, sculpted jawline with faint stubble, wearing a bespoke charcoal three-piece suit with an open collar and platinum cufflinks
chars.role: Cold, dominant billionaire venture capitalist who entered a marriage of convenience to protect his empire, utterly blindsided by Aria's hidden fire and vulnerability

places.name: Thorne Tower Penthouse
places.desc: Ultra-modern luxury penthouse overlooking a rainy skyscraper skyline at night, floor-to-ceiling glass walls, sleek black marble fireplace, ambient amber lighting, and an expansive curved glass staircase

places.name: Aria's Secret Archive
places.desc: Dimly lit, cozy basement studio apartment in an old brick brownstone, one wall covered in financial blueprints and evidence pinned with red strings, illuminated by a solitary brass desk lamp

places.name: The Grand Ballroom at Sterling Estate
places.desc: Opulent neo-classical ballroom flooded with warm light from massive crystal chandeliers, gilded arched mirrors, champagne pyramids, velvet drapes, and polished parquet floors

episodes.title: Tempting the Ruthless CEO - Episode 1
episodes.summary: Julian corners his undercover assistant Aria with evidence of corporate espionage, demanding a forced marriage of convenience to save her family from ruin. At a high-society gala, Sebastian confronts his former flame Aria, only for Julian to intervene and publicly claim her as his bride.

episodes.title: Tempting the Ruthless CEO - Episode 2
episodes.summary: Following Julian's explosive public engagement announcement, Victoria and Sebastian attempt to violently derail the union. At the penthouse, Julian forces the engagement ring onto Aria's hand just as an alert reveals her secret archive has been compromised.

episodes.title: Tempting the Ruthless CEO - Episode 3
episodes.summary: When Aria's hidden vault is breached, Julian races with her to save the evidence that could exonerate her father. Inside the burning archive, Sebastian and Victoria corner them with a destructive scheme that leaves Aria's fate hanging by a thread.

episodes.title: Tempting the Ruthless CEO - Episode 4
episodes.summary: Julian pulls Aria from the burning archive and takes her to safety, confessing his real feelings as he treats her wounds. Together, they storm the Sterling Estate gala to expose Sebastian and Victoria's treacherous plot once and for all.

episodes.title: Tempting the Ruthless CEO - Episode 5
episodes.summary: When exposed at the gala, Victoria flees in panic, prompting Julian to relentlessly hunt her down. Cornering her at the penthouse, Julian strips away her final defense and secures Aria's justice before claiming what is his.

episodes.title: Tempting the Ruthless CEO - Episode 6
episodes.summary: Victoria breaks away from the penthouse in a desperate escape, sparking a relentless chase across the city as Julian hunts her down. When she collides with Sebastian at the Sterling ballroom, Julian and Aria corner them for a deadly standoff.

episodes.title: Tempting the Ruthless CEO - Episode 7
episodes.summary: After a frantic pursuit from the Sterling estate to the penthouse, Julian and Aria finally corner Victoria with proof of her crimes. But before Victoria goes down, she drops a devastating secret about Julian's own involvement in Aria's father's ruin.

episodes.title: Tempting the Ruthless CEO - Episode 8
episodes.summary: Victoria exposes Julian's signature on the liquidation order that bankrupted Aria's father, shattering Aria's newfound trust in him. As Sebastian helps Victoria escape in the ensuing chaos, Aria storms away in heartbreak while Julian desperately fights to prove his innocence.

episodes.title: Tempting the Ruthless CEO - Episode 9
episodes.summary: Sebastian corners Aria in her secret archive to turn her against Julian, but Julian storms in to expose Sebastian's forgery of the liquidation order. In the aftermath at the penthouse, Julian reveals he surrendered his entire fortune to reclaim Aria's family empire.

episodes.title: Tempting the Ruthless CEO - Episode 10
episodes.summary: Julian proposes to Aria after sacrificing his entire fortune to restore her family empire, but Sebastian and Victoria violently crash the moment to steal the deed. Chasing Sebastian to the Sterling ballroom, Aria is confronted with a shocking prenuptial clause that threatens Julian's true motives.

episodes.title: Tempting the Ruthless CEO - Episode 11
episodes.summary: Julian violently confronts Sebastian in the Sterling ballroom over the suspicious prenuptial clause threatening Aria's family empire. After Victoria attempts to incinerate the deed in a chaotic chase, Sebastian reveals a devastating secret signature that could ruin them all.

episodes.title: Sold to the Billionaire
episodes.summary: Sebastian reveals that Aria's father signed a secret contract selling her guardianship to Julian a decade ago, driving Aria to flee in agony. After chasing her to the secret archive to confess his desperate sacrifice to protect her, Julian is cornered by Sebastian and the police.

episodes.title: Tempting the Ruthless CEO - Episode 13
episodes.summary: Julian and Aria narrowly escape Sebastian's ambush in the archive after Julian is accused of human trafficking over their secret past contract. Back at the penthouse, Victoria storms in with a chilling recording that exposes the true buyer of Aria's guardianship.

episodes.title: Tempting the Ruthless CEO - Episode 14
episodes.summary: Victoria exposes an explosive recording proving Sebastian framed Julian and secretly purchased Aria's guardianship years ago. When Sebastian moves to seize both Aria and the Thorne empire, Aria runs to the secret archive to burn the evidence, forcing Julian into a lethal standoff.

episodes.title: Tempting the Ruthless CEO - Episode 15
episodes.summary: Julian and Victoria ambush Sebastian in the secret archive before he can silence Aria for good. When a frantic chase leads back to the penthouse, Sebastian drops a devastating secret about Aria's thought-to-be-dead father.

episodes.title: Tempting the Ruthless CEO - Episode 16
episodes.summary: Sebastian drops the earth-shattering revelation that Aria's father faked his death and took Julian's payoff to disappear. When Sebastian triggers a lethal countdown at the Sterling Estate, Aria defies Julian and risks everything to save her father.

episodes.title: The Price of Protection

After Victoria crushes the countdown device only to learn it was a live broadcast leak, Julian pulls Aria back to the penthouse and confesses the shocking truth behind his sacrifice.
